newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Shippers demand 15 pct cut in Karachi port tariff.
newsitem.headline: Shippers demand 15 pct cut in Karachi port tariff.

text.p: The All Pakistan Shipping Association (APSA) on Friday urged Karachi Port to cut tariffs 15 percent to encourage use of the port.

The lower tariff on port call costs, ship handling and wharfage would encourage greater use of the port by shipping lines and shippers, Farrukh Qaisar, APSA chairman said in a statement after meeting port chairman Khalid Mir.
Mir had also informed Qaiser about a plan for a round-the-clock container operation, he said and added: "This will be a prelude to the concept of the off-dock container freight station."
